title: Baleswari Odia words
speaker: Musamoni Panigrahi
description: Words in the Baleswari variety of Odia spoken by Musamoni Panigrahi, one recording each. Subhashish Panigrahi recorded her telling stories and singing in 2014 and 2015, and the words were taken from those recordings, including the stories "Budhi Asuruni" and "Budhara Kukura - Budhira Biradi".
